svg.text: Paata — direct wiring, no headers (what goes on each pad)
Each coloured stub is one wire; the label says where its other end goes. Blocks show pad order as printed on each board, not where the boards sit.
header pins already fitted; SD pads bare
on the far edge of the same board
* short link on the display itself:
solder to the back of the header
pin, so the ESP32 needs only one
wire each for SCK and SDA.
no header: solder to the pads
Small breadboard: power rails + the two buttons
BACK: one side to pad 15, other side to − rail. OK: pad 16 and − rail.
solder the wire to this pad
push a jumper socket onto the existing pin
